label: Burlington Composite Squadron
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions

artwork.format: webp (lossy, with alpha) -> png via dwebp

ground_removed.colour: none: the ground was already clear (alpha 3 or less, white or black colour under it)
ground_removed.flood: 4-neighbour flood from the picture's edge over pixels with alpha 3 or less

band.rule: alpha from the pixel colour's place between white and the outline's solid colour, colour taken from the outline

provenance: Unit emblem of Burlington Composite Squadron (MAR-NC-022), digital artwork supplied by Ethan Hillard on 2026-11-12. Official digital artwork shipped as given: webp (lossy, with alpha, 1632 x 1062 px) -> png via dwebp; the file came with its ground already clear (1261458 px of alpha 3 or less, reached by a flood from the picture's edge) but with a feathered edge: the alpha rose over about 12 px from the ground to the gold outline while the colours there were pale (white mixed into the gold), a glow round the outline on a dark garment. On 2026-11-12 the 18549 px of that edge were given their alpha from where their colour lies between white and the outline's own solid colour (#f9ba01) and took that colour, so the outline's outer edge is a few pixels wide and no pale fringe is left (7697 of them, nearly clear before, are clear), and the picture was trimmed to the emblem's box (1632 x 1062 px to 714 x 822 px; the result is 8-bit RGBA); the white triangle behind the propeller and the white stripe of the diagonal band are untouched (6187 and 7124 px of near-white before and after); no resampling, no redrawing, no tracing, no other colour change. Charter: MAR-NC-022 is the only unit named Burlington Composite Squadron in the builder's unit list (the other Burlington unit, NCR-IA-005, is a flight); the motto DOUBLE DEUCES names its number, 22.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only changes are the feathered edge, made a clean outline so the emblem sits on the garment, and the trim to the emblem's box.
